summary: CDW LLC and CDW Finance Corporation completed a registered offering of $1.5 billion of senior notes across three tranches: $600 million 5.700% notes due 2029 at 99.908%, $500 million 6.100% notes due 2032 at par, and $400 million 6.350% notes due 2033 at 99.805%. CDW Corporation fully and unconditionally guarantees the notes on an unsecured senior basis; no subsidiary guarantees apply. Interest pays semi-annually beginning March 2027 for the 2029 and 2033 notes and January 2027 for the 2032 notes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
